definitions.explanation: The natural periodic state of rest in which the body recovers.

examples.japanese: {十分|じゅうぶん}な{睡眠|すいみん}を{取|と}ることが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: It's important to get enough sleep.

examples.japanese: {睡眠|すいみん}{不足|ぶそく}で{頭|あたま}がぼんやりする。
examples.english: My head is fuzzy from lack of sleep.

examples.japanese: {睡眠|すいみん}の{質|しつ}を{改善|かいぜん}したい。
examples.english: I want to improve my sleep quality.

notes:
{睡眠|すいみん} is the formal/medical term for sleep.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {睡眠|すいみん}を{取|と}る (to get sleep)
- {睡眠|すいみん}{不足|ぶそく} (lack of sleep, sleep deprivation)
- {睡眠|すいみん}{時間|じかん} (sleep time, hours of sleep)
- {睡眠|すいみん}{障害|しょうがい} (sleep disorder)
- {睡眠|すいみん}の{質|しつ} (sleep quality)
- {睡眠|すいみん}{薬|やく} (sleeping pill)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {睡眠|すいみん}: sleep (formal, medical term)
- {眠|ねむ}り: sleep (poetic, literary)
- {眠|ねむ}る: to sleep (verb, everyday usage)
- {寝|ね}る: to sleep, to go to bed (more casual)
